headline: Rare Vampirella 1969 debut heads to auction
post:

From her wild sci-fi origins on planet Drakulon to legendary runs by writers like Grant Morrison and Christopher Priest, this classic character has a surprisingly rich history outside of Marvel and DC.

headline: Vision's Wild Comic Book Family Tree
post:
The synthezoid has one of the most complex lineages in the comics, according to Screen Rant. His bizarre relatives span both magic and science. Hank Pym is considered his grandfather because Pym created Ultron, and Ultron is Vision's father. Even wilder, Ultron used Simon Williams's brain patterns, making Wonder Man a brother of sorts to Vision.

The tree gets even more tangled from there. Jim Hammond is connected as a physical twin or brother due to the template and spare parts used during construction. Meanwhile, characters like Victor Mancha and Jocasta share connections through Ultron. Jocasta can be viewed as both a sister and a stepmother. Following the recently concluded "VisionQuest" series, looking back at these strange comic ties is quite a journey.

Who is your favorite character in this family tree? 🤖🧬📖 #Marvel #Vision #ScreenRant
original_title: Vision's Entire Family Tree Across All Marvel Lore

headline: Iman Vellani reveals the ultimate X-Men story
post:
Hey Marvel fam! Did you know our favorite MCU star, Iman Vellani, is sharing her top comic picks while co-hosting a special podcast? According to /Film, the actress recently opened up about why she considers Chris Claremont and Brent Anderson's 1982 graphic novel, "X-Men: God Loves, Man Kills" to be an absolute masterpiece. 📚

Vellani praised the book as "the purest distillation of what these characters represent," pointing to its dark exploration of a televangelist villain preaching hatred against mutants. The story features the X-Men teaming up with Magneto to stop Reverend William Stryker's deadly crusade, diving into heavy real-world parallels and intense themes.

While the 2000s movie trilogy pulled away from these specific religious elements, this iconic graphic novel remains a massive piece of Marvel history. Have you ever read this classic X-Men comic?

#MsMarvel #XMen #MarvelComics
original_title: Ms. Marvel Star Iman Vellani Believes This Is The Perfect X-Men Story (And She's Right)
